explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 86 named tracks across Hard Wax's live September 2026 current/reissue field, official Bandcamp and label pages for exact-track checks, and adjacent catalogue follow-through. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Completed Runs 214, 217, 218, 219, 221 and 222 selected identities and tested boundaries were excluded; unresolved, duplicate, rejected and untriggered PARKED identities were not reused.

Every exact artist/title pair below was checked against the canonical ledger, discoveries, target-local discovery pool, active rejections, PARKED revisit queue and global utility ledger before ranking; none was present.
The repetition check compared the previous five completed discovery runs (217, 218, 219, 221 and 222). None of the nine placements repeats a selected-candidate boundary from those runs.
The three strongest leads come from three releases and carry candidate-specific information. Lower-ranked leads preserve release-level evidence limits rather than inventing individual behavior.

Nine honest leads survived without padding. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and both protected handoffs remain untouched. No Spotify connector, raw audio, invented identity or metadata-to-feeling inference was used.
